paite: Huan Jesu'n sawm-le-nihte asamkhawm a, dawi nin tengteng tung a thilhihtheihna leh natnate hihdamtheihna thuneihna apia hi.
heading: Sawltak Sawm-le-nihte Sawlkhiakna / (Mat 10.5-15; Mar 6.7-13)
english: He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

paite: Huchi in Pathian lalgam thu gen ding leh damloute hihdam ding in asawlkheta hi.
english: He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.

paite: Akiang uah, "Zinna a ding in chiangkhun hiam, kawlzal hiam, tanghou hiam, dangka hiam, bangmah keng kei un; puanak nih leng keng kei un.
english: He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—no staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money. Don’t have two tunics each.

paite: Na tunna inn uah tung kinken unla, huai inn a kipan paikhia un.
english: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.

paite: Huan ahon kipahpih lou peuhmah huai khua a kipan na paikhiak chiang un amau mohpaihna ding in na khepek ua leivui tatkhia un,” achi hi.
english: As many as don’t receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.”

paite: Huchi in akuanta ua, khua atawn vialvial uhi. Gam chih ah tanchinhoih ahilh ua, mi ahihdam zel uhi.
english: They departed and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News and healing everywhere.

paite: Huan kumpipa Herod in athilhih tengteng uh ana za a; khenkhat in, "Johan hing nawnta ahi, achi ua, khenkhat in,
heading: Herod Lungbuaina / (Mat 14.1-12; Mar 6.14-29)
english: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,

paite: Elijah hong kilak ahi, achi ua, khenkhat in, nidanglai zawlnei kuahiam thounawnta ahi," achih ziak un, alungzingta hi.
english: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.

paite: Herod in, "Johan alu ka tanta a; himahleh hichi lawmlawm a athu ka zakzak kua ahia?" chi in amah muh atumta hi.
english: Herod said, “I beheaded John, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.

paite: Huan sawltakte ahong kik nawn un, akiang ah athilhihte uh ahilh ua, ama'n amaute pi in khopi Bethsaida kichi ah apaituamta hi.
heading: Mipi Sangnga Vakna / (Mat 14.13-21; Mar 6.30-44; Joh 6.1-14)
english: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them and withdrew apart to a desert region of a city called Bethsaida.

paite: Himahleh mipi'n athei ua, azui zel uh; ama'n amaute ana kipahpih a, Pathian lalgam thu ahilh a, hihdam kiphamoh peuhmahte ahihdam hi.
english: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, spoke to them of God’s Kingdom, and he cured those who needed healing.

paite: Huan nitaklam ahong hi dekta a; sawm-le-nihte ahong pai ua, akiang ah, "Khuate leh akim gam ah giahna leh annek-tuidawn zong ding in mipite paisak tanla; gamkeu mun a om hi ngal hang a," achi uhi.
english: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came and said to him, “Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms and lodge and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.”

paite: Ama'n bel akiang uah, "Nou nek ding pia un," achi hi. Amau, “Mi hiai zahzah nek ding i va leisak keileh, tanghou phel nga leh nga nih kia lou ngal bangmah i nei kei uh," achi uhi.
english: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”

paite: Piching ngen leng sangnga phial ahi uhi. Huan anungzuite kiang ah, "Mite apawlpawl in tusak un, sawmnga zel in,” achi hi.
english: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”

paite: Huchi in ahih ua, atusak vekta uhi.
english: They did so, and made them all sit down.

paite: Huan tanghou phel nga leh ngasa nih ala a, van lam en in avualzawl a, abalkham a, mipi ma a lui ding in anungzuite kiang ah apia hi.
english: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.

paite: Huan ane ua, avah chiatta ua, akhamval nengte uh bawm sawm-le-nih aluakdim uhi.
english: They ate and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu amah kia a athum lai in akiang ah anungzuite a-om ua; akiang uah, "Mipite'n kua ka hi ahon chi ua?" chi in adong hi.
heading: Peter In Jesu Khrist Apuangkhia / (Mat 16.13-19; Mar 8.27-29)
english: As he was praying alone, the disciples were near him, and he asked them, “Who do the multitudes say that I am?”

paite: Amau, "Baptispa Johan ahon chi ua; himahleh khenkhat in, Elijah hiam nidanglai zawlnei kuahiam thounawn ahon chi uh," chi in adawng uhi.
english: They answered, “‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets has risen again.”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Ahihleh nou kua ka hi na hon chi ua?" achi hi. Peter in, "Pathian Khrist mah," chi in adawng hi.
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”

paite: Huan huai thu kuamah hilh louh ding chi bikbek in, thu apia hi:
heading: Jesu'n Asihna leh Thohnawnna Ding Agenkhol / (Mat 16.20-28; Mar 8.30-9.1)
english: But he warned them and commanded them to tell this to no one,

paite: "Mihing Tapa in thil tampi athuak dia, upate, siampu liante leh laigelhmite deih louh in a-om ding, thah in a-om dia, ani thum ni in kaihthoh in a-om ding," achi hi.
english: saying, “The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.”

paite: Huan mi tengteng kiang ah, "Kuapeuh in hon zuih a-utleh amah kingaihsak lou in, niteng a ama kros pua in hon zui hen.
heading: Eimah Kipai Dia Chihna / (Mat 10.34-37; Mar 8.34-38)
english: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

paite: Kuapeuh ahinna humbit ut in atan ding; kuapeuh keimah ziak a ahinna tan in ahumbit ding.
english: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake will save it.

paite: Mi'n khovel apum in nei henla, amah kimangsak hiam, ahihkeileh kimanlohleh amah a ding in bang aphatuam dia?
english: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?

paite: Kuapeuh keimah leh ka thu zahpihmi zaw Mihing Tapa in ama thupina toh, a Pa thupina leh a-angel siangthoute thupina toh ahong pai hun chiang in azahpih ding hi.
english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.

paite: Diktak in ka hon hilh ahi, hiai a dinghte akhen, Pathian lalgam amuh masiah uh sihna chiam lou hial ding a-om uh," achi hi.
english: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here who will in no way taste of death until they see God’s Kingdom.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n athugen nung ni giat hiam in, Peter, Johan leh Jakob api a, thum ding in tang ah ahohtou uhi.
heading: Mellamdanna / (Mat 17.1-13; Mar 9.2-13)
english: About eight days after these sayings, he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.

paite: Athum lai in amel omdan ahong lamdang a, apuansilhte mi lengthei in ahong ngouta hi.
english: As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.

paite: Huan ngai in, mi nih amah toh akihou ua, huai mite Mosi leh Elijah ahi uh.
english: Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,

paite: Thupina a kithuam in akilak ua, Jerusalem a sihna ahih bukim ding thu agen uhi.
english: who appeared in glory and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.

paite: Peter leh alawmte bel a-ihmut uh asuak a, himahleh ahak teitei ua athupina leh akiang a mi nih dinghte amu uhi.
english: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men who stood with him.

paite: Huan huai mite'n Jesu apaisan dek lai un, Peter in Jesu kiang ah, "Heutupa, ei a ding in hiai a om ahoih, aidakbuk thum i khoh dia, nang a ding in khat, Mosi a ding in khat, Elijah a ding in khat, achi a, athugen leng theiloupi in."
english: As they were parting from him, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah,” not knowing what he said.

paite: Huan huai thute agen lai in mei ahong kai a, amau aliahta; mei lak a alut lai un alau uhi.
english: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.

paite: Meipi a kipan aw ahong suak a, "Hiai ka Tapa, ka tel ahi, amah thu ngai un," achi hi.
english: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!”

paite: Huan aw adaihtak in Jesu kia amuta uhi. Huan adai dide ua, huai lai in athil muh uh kuamah bangmah ahilh kei uhi.
english: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, azing in tang a kipan apaisuk nung un, mipi tampitak in amah ana dawn uhi.
heading: Pasal Naupang Dawimat Hihdamna / (Mat 17.14-21; Mar 9.14-29)
english: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.

paite: Ngai in, mipi lak ah mi khat akikou a, "Sinsakpa, ka tapa en ding in ka hon ngen ahi, amah ka tapa neihsun ahi.
english: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only born child.

paite: Ngai in, dawi in aman a, akikoukhe guih zel a; huchi in achilphuan ke hial in agimbawl a, nakpitak a hih sidup in apaisan zel hi.
english: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams; and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.

paite: Na nungzuite kiang ah delhkhe ding in ka ngen na a, ahihthei kei uh," achi hi.
english: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n, "Ginna nei lou khang leh lampialte aw, bang tan ahia ka hon thuak theih ding? Hiai ah na tapa hon pi in," chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”

paite: Huan ahong pai lai in dawi in ahihpuk ek a, nakpitak in agimbawlta hi; himahleh Jesu'n dawi nin atai a, naupang ahihdam a, apa kiang ah apaisak nawnta hi.
english: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.

paite: Huan mi tengteng in Pathian thupidan lamdang asa mahmah uhi. Huchi in mi tengteng in athilhih tengteng lamdang asak lai un, Jesu'n anungzuite kiang ah,
heading: Jesu'n Asihna Ding Agenkholh Nihveina / (Mat 17.22-23; Mar 9.30-32)
english: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

paite: "Hiai thute na bil uah lut hen. Mihingte khut a Mihing Tapa matsak a om ding ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: “Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.”

paite: Himahleh athugen atheisiam kei uh, atheihtheihlouhna ding ua kisel ahi, huai thugen tanchin amah adong ngam kei uhi.
english: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.

paite: Huan alak uah kua athupipen dia? chih thu in ana kisel uhi.
heading: Kingaihniamna Dik / (Mat 18.1-5; Mar 9.33-37)
english: An argument arose among them about which of them was the greatest.

paite: Jesu'n alungtang ua angaihtuah uh athei a, naupang neu khat akai a, asik ah a-omsak a, akiang uah,
english: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,

paite: "Kuapeuh ka min ziak a hiai naupang neu kipahpih keimah hon kipahpih ahi ding uh; keimah hon kipahpih hon sawlpa kipahpih ahi; na vek ua lak a neupen athupipen ahi ding," achi hi.
english: and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.”

paite: Johan in, “Heutupa, kuahiam na min a dawite delkhia ka mu ua, ka hon zuihna ua apan louh ziak in ka khamta uhi,” chi in adawng hi.
english: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Kham nawn kei un, kuapeuh nou hon dal lou nou lam a pang ahi," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, amah pitouh hun ding anaitak in, Jerusalem a hoh atum tinten a, ama ah mi ama taisak hi.
heading: Samari Mite'n Jesu Ngai Lou
english: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem

paite: Huan apai ua, amah a dia na kimansak ding in Samari mite khua khat ah alut uhi.
english: and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

paite: Amai Jerusalem kholam naih a alat ziak in amah ana kipahpih kei uhi.
english: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in anungzui Jakob leh Johan in huai atheih un, "Toupa, amaute kangmang ding in, Elijah hih bang in van a kipan mei hong ke ding a thu ka piak uh hoih na sa hia?" achi uhi.
english: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”

paite: Amah akihei a, amau tai in, "Bang kha a pan na hi ua chih thei lou na hi uhiam?
english: But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.

paite: Mihing Tapa mite hihmangthang ding hilou in, hondam ding a hong pai ahi zaw hi,” achi hi. Huan kho dang ah apaita uhi.
english: For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.

paite: Huan lampi a apai lai un, kuahiam in akiang ah, "Na paina peuh ah ka hon zui ding," achi hi.
heading: Nungzui Dingte Theihna / (Mat 8.19-22)
english: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Sehalte'n kua anei ua, tungleng vasate'n leng bu anei uh, himahleh Mihing Tapa in zaw alu ngakna ding mun anei kei," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”

paite: Jesu'n midang kiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi hi. Himahleh ama'n, "Toupa, ka pa hon vuisak phot in," achi hi.
english: He said to another, “Follow me!” But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Misite'n amisi uh kivui uhen; nang Pathian lalgam thu va gen zaw in," achi hi.
english: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce God’s Kingdom.”

paite: Huan midang in leng, "Toupa, ka hon zui ding, himahleh ka inn a mite kampha in hon khasak phot in," achi hi.
english: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang ah, "Kuapeuh leilehna len a, nunglam nga Pathian kumpigam mi hi tak ahi kei," achi hi.
english: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”
